# Greenwood International Academy — EduCore School Portal

> CBSE & IB K-12 School Campus in Baner Annexe, Pune powered by EduCore ERP v4.2.

## Public Pages
- [School Home](/): Overview of academics, campus highlights, notices, and admissions.
- [About Greenwood](/about): Mission, leadership, CBSE Affiliation #2730841, and ISO 21001:2018 quality standards.
- [Academics & Curriculum](/academics): Pre-Primary, Primary, Middle, and Senior Secondary subjects and assessment calendar.
- [Admissions 2026–27](/admissions): Fee tiers, eligibility, seat availability, and 4-step admission process.
- [Online Admission Enquiry](/apply): Submit an online student admission enquiry for AY 2026–27.
- [Campus Life & Facilities](/campus-life): 22 STEM & Robotics labs, 18,400+ volume library, 18 GPS-tracked bus routes, and hostel dining.
- [Official Notices](/notices): Active academic circulars, PTM invitations, and uniform notices.
- [Events Calendar](/events): Upcoming exams, Science Expo, PTMs, and fee due dates.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](/faq): Portal access, fee receipts, and GPS bus notification guidance.
- [Contact Us](/contact): 42 Knowledge Park Boulevard, Baner Annexe, Pune 411045 • +91 20 6789 4200.

## Portal Entry Points (Authenticated)
